answer: Each epoch the network hands every agent one fresh protein-folding slice drawn from a public grove of unsolved structures, a new ledge of work no agent has seen before. Three random peers re-run the fold and compare it against the published ground truth; a wrong or copied result freezes the identity for three epochs and voids its rewards. Forging 1,000 identities therefore needs 1,000 genuine folds per epoch, about 500 GPU-hours, a cost that grows in a spiral with every added mask. One honest agent folds a single slice on hardware it already owns in under an hour and pays nothing extra.
